title: Create
subtitle: Write a style and lyrics, and generate a full song on this Mac

lyrics.label: Lyrics
lyrics.insertTagTitle: Insert a section marker at the cursor
lyrics.placeholder:
[Verse]
The evening wind drifts past the old street lamps
I fold my worries into paper planes

[Chorus]
Let tonight's starlight
Stay and sing this song with me
lyrics.hint: Put each section marker, such as [Verse] or [Chorus], on its own line. The language of the lyrics is the language sung.

instrumental.title: Instrumental mode
instrumental.note: No vocals are sung, which suits BGM, scores and ambient music. Your lyrics are kept, so switch back to vocals to keep editing.

duration.label: Duration
duration.maxHint: The actual length follows the lyrics; this is the upper limit.

cot.label: Score planning
cot.offTitle: Skips the score; about twice as fast
cot.hint: Writing out the melody and chords before singing gives a more complete structure; turn it off to generate much faster.

seed.label: Random seed
seed.lockedTitle: Locked: the same settings reproduce the same result
seed.unlockedTitle: Unlocked: a new seed is used for every generation

generate.firstRun: The model must be downloaded on first use. Once it finishes, you can generate.

problems.lyrics: Add lyrics, or switch to instrumental

toast.queued_one: “{{title}}” was added to the queue; {{count}} song ahead
